latestVersion.changelog:
bird-info v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Bird Info Skill.
- Allows users to query detailed bird species information from dongniao.net using web_fetch.
- Supports Chinese, English, and scientific bird names with fuzzy matching.
- Extracts structured data on features, habitat, distribution, and conservation status.
- Provides clean, readable output with source attribution and detailed error handling.
